description.value: O'Flannigan's is a New York-style Irish pub situated in the heart of downtown Kelowna, directly behind the historic Royal Anne Hotel on Queensway Avenue. It hosts live bands most weekends alongside comedy nights, karaoke, and open-mic events, with three garage-style doors that open to the street in summer. An attached cold beer and liquor store next door rounds out the offering for visitors looking to extend the evening.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetched successfully and the about/contact page provides the phone number (250) 763-2292 and full address 319 Queensway Avenue, Kelowna, BC V1Y 8E6, corroborating the OSM street address. Upcoming live-music events listed through late 2026 confirm the business is actively operating. The website contains no mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so all those fields remain null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
